messages:
rachel-ae: Heads up: attaching the draft RFP response for Meridian Health. Main unknowns: HSM passthrough language, POC duration/pricing, sample capability matrix, and data ingress controls. Can we review?
mike-se: I'll take POC ops + runbook. Do we want a two-week sandbox or 30-day trial? Two-week keeps costs down.
tess-product: I'll own the capability matrix. Proposing explicit metric cells: baseline tokens/sec, burst window, latency SLA, model variants, cost delta. Short descriptions only.
nana-sec: For dataset ingress: pre-signed S3 + temporary peering + DAA signed by their security. Retention: default 7 days after teardown unless otherwise requested. KMS: we need their KMS ARN for passthrough review.
omar-legal: I'll add a KMS clause and a short data addendum template. Note: reserved capacity pilots trigger different indemnity wording.
rachel-ae: Mike, can you give a back-of-envelope for 1M tokens/day with 40% bursts for 2 weeks on Dedicated?
mike-se: Rough: baseline reserved prorated ~$6k for 2 weeks, burst premiums ~ $0.025/token during peak. Will put details in spreadsheet.
tess-product: Matrix snippet:
| Offering | Baseline TPS | Burst window | SLA | Fallback | Cost note |
| Hosted | 400 t/s | 2m | best-effort | 7B quant | lower cost |
| Dedicated | 4k t/s | 10m | p99 latency SLA | compatible model | reserved + burst |
| Private | infra-dependent | n/a | customer-managed | none | varies |
rachel-ae: Ana, can we say FedRAMP is "assessment planned"? They asked specifically.
nana-sec: Yes: "SOC2 Type II available; FedRAMP assessment for Private offering planned with target FY next year. Contact security@redwood.com for interim evidence."
omar-legal: Sharing redacted SOW links: https://redwood.internal/sow-templates/midsize-redacted.pdf
infra-bot: provision-sandbox: meridian-sbx created id sbx-9987; logs to ops-sys.
mike-se: I'll add teardown steps: revoke peering, delete bucket, rotate keys, confirm logs exported. ETA 3pm PT.
tess-product: Also include two-line quantization blurb: "8-bit/4-bit reduce memory and cost; run evals to validate quality; Redwood Optimize flags regressions."
rachel-ae: Great. I'll compile RFP packet after 3pm review and send. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
